programmes.d: Ted takes a huge Michigan deer with an old Bear Razor broadhead while Shemane sets her sights on Fallow Deer in Texas.

The Slock Master reveals the tricks and tips that fool predators. Bowhunting coyotes, fox, lion, bobcat and more with incredible close-up call-ins and amazing archery action. Watch the world's top bow hunter slock 'em on The Slock Master.

In the land of Elvis, Red O'Hearn, Neil Davis, and Mark Steck enjoy themselves on Red's trapline. There's plenty of trapping, plenty of insults, and plenty of plain old fun as these three late 60s trappers appreciate the good life they live.
